title: AFSP v0.1 common definitions
description: Shared definitions referenced by every AFSP v0.1 document schema.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (AFSP uses UTC throughout). The reference implementation emits YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and accepts Z or +00:00 with optional fractional seconds.

validity.description: A validity window of two ISO 8601 UTC timestamps (§6.1 validity_window, §7.3 temporal_validity, §8.3).

signature_value.description: ECDSA-P256/SHA-256 signature in its one accepted encoding: strict DER, low-S (s <= n/2), standard base64 with padding, no whitespace (Appendix A 'MEUCIQ...'). Verifiers reject raw r||s, high-S, base64url, missing padding and non-minimal DER (bad_signature): accepting several encodings of one signature would make it malleable. Signers may produce any form; signing libraries convert it. Reference proposal P2, pending §18.

algorithm.description: The only signature algorithm AFSP v0.1 permits (§3.4).

certificate_chain.description: Base64 DER X.509 certificate(s), leaf first: one string or an array (§6.1, §8.3).

signature_block.description: A signature block (platform_signature, institution_signature, registry_signature, issuer_signature, attestation, signature). The signing input is the RFC 8785 canonical form of the whole document with only the block's `signature` member removed (reference proposal pending §18).

signed_by.description: Signing party (packages, session tokens, audit records: platform.afsp.org, §6.1) or signing key identifier.

signed_with.description: Signing key identifier (§9.4 names the key member signed_with).

statement.description: Provider statement about how an S5 score was derived (§11.2).

jwk.description: A P-256 public key as a JWK (RFC 7517). AFSP v0.1 permits ECDSA-P256 only (§3.4).

jwk_thumbprint.description: RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint (SHA-256, base64url, no padding).

sha256_ref.description: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> reference to a digest (build hashes, authorization token hashes, audit references). Authorization token hashes and audit signal hashes are over the RFC 8785 form of the whole object, signature included.

hex_nonce_256.description: Nonce of at least 256 bits, lowercase hex (consumed as a string, so one spelling per nonce).

package_id.description: pkg_ followed by a unique identifier of at least 128 bits in lowercase hex (§6.1: 256-bit).

session_id.description: sess_ followed by a session correlation identifier in lowercase hex (§6.1).

action_class.description: Action classes (§4.3, §7.4), in ascending order of consequence.

s5_signal_type.description: S5 signal types (§4.3, §11.2); AMBIENT_ENVIRONMENT_CONSISTENCY is optional (§11.4 ECL).

certification_status.description: Certification status of an agent or signal provider (reference proposal).

tee_attestation.description: Hardware attestation from the device TEE.

preference_weights.description: Consumer preference weights (§7.3, §9.3, §9.5); they sum to 1.0.
